localTools: FFmpeg with libx264, AAC, overlay, scale, crop, pad, concat, afade, amix and alimiter filters
notes: Run npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund once to install pinned Sharp 0.34.5 dependencies; setup requires network access but rendering does not.
Arial/Helvetica/sans-serif fonts are resolved on the host; inspect typography on each new platform. No external font download is required.
All real gameplay, avatars, and dialogue audio must be explicitly authorized; no voice cloning is implemented.
Bundled diagnostic video patterns and sine tones are original mechanical fixtures only.
Only the available macOS environment was tested.
